verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents a built-in AI assistant, Composer, that takes a stated goal and builds the audience, drafts content, maps the send strategy, and makes supported changes for user review. The pricing page also lists assistant tasks such as scheduling recurring tasks, creating campaigns and flows, and answering questions from data, and the homepage pitches campaigns built 'from a single prompt'. The MCP server is external-agent access, not a built-in assistant, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of which actions Composer can and cannot perform ('supported changes' is undefined), and any independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works as marketed.
